title: Ten numbers from the Laplace–Beltrami spectrum facilitate training-free classification of protein structures based on surface shape
authors: Fernández-Giro M; Emonts J; Berkels B; Buyel JF
one_liner_zh: 该文利用Laplace–Beltrami谱的前10个特征值编码蛋白质表面形状，实现无需训练的结构分类，属于蛋白质结构计算分析，但方法创新性有限且未涉及生成或采样。
abstract: The comparison of protein structures is necessary to determine molecular functions and evolutionary relationships and can also facilitate drug design and the prediction of separation options. The number of available protein structures is rapidly increasing, driven by experimental determination but also prediction methods such as AlphaFold. In this context, traditional structure comparison based on atomic superposition becomes computationally inefficient. To enable scalable analysis and surface shape comparison, alternative approaches represent protein structures using compact, fixed-length vectors known as descriptors. Current vectors often contain hundreds of entries, such as three-dimensional Zernike descriptors composed of 121 entries, or combinations of molecular and geometric properties. Here, we propose to use the Laplace–Beltrami spectrum, a mathematical representation of object surfaces derived from the eigenvalues of the Laplace–Beltrami operator, as an efficient option to capture protein structural properties and facilitate structural classification. Specifically, protein surfaces are encoded using only the first 10 non-zero eigenvalues of this spectrum. We used the SHREC 2025 dataset as a benchmark and achieved 85.8% accuracy on the original 97 protein structure classes and 97.7% accuracy on the homology-grouped 45 classes. Our method is fast, requiring ∼75 min computation time for the 11,555 protein surface meshes of the SHREC 2025 dataset on a conventional AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core processor with 32 GB RAM. The approach can easily be applied to large protein structure databases because it is readily parallelizable and allows the incorporation of other descriptors, including surface features such as charge. This rapid screening tool can therefore be used to identify proteins with related surface shapes independent of sequence homology.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构的比较对于确定分子功能和进化关系是必要的，同时也能促进药物设计和分离方案预测。可用蛋白质结构的数量正在迅速增加，这得益于实验测定以及诸如AlphaFold等预测方法。在此背景下，基于原子叠加的传统结构比较在计算上变得效率低下。为了实现可扩展的分析和表面形状比较，替代方法使用紧凑的固定长度向量（称为描述符）来表示蛋白质结构。当前向量通常包含数百个条目，例如由121个条目组成的三维Zernike描述符，或分子与几何特性的组合。在此，我们提出使用Laplace–Beltrami谱，这是一种通过Laplace–Beltrami算子特征值导出的物体表面的数学表示，作为捕获蛋白质结构特性并促进结构分类的高效选项。具体而言，蛋白质表面仅使用该谱的前10个非零特征值进行编码。我们以SHREC 2025数据集为基准，在原始97个蛋白质结构类别上实现了85.8%的准确率，在同源分组后的45个类别上实现了97.7%的准确率。我们的方法速度快，在配备32 GB RAM的常规AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8核处理器上，处理SHREC 2025数据集的11,555个蛋白质表面网格仅需约75分钟计算时间。该方法易于应用于大型蛋白质结构数据库，因为它易于并行化，并允许纳入其他描述符，包括诸如电荷等表面特征。因此，这种快速筛选工具可用于识别具有相关表面形状的蛋白质，而不依赖于序列同源性。
